text:
lia-support: Customer reported repeated 429s from /v1/rerank despite their overall RPM being well under account quota. They see it only for requests with large candidate arrays (~150-300).

ashley-customer: seeing `429` with body "rate limit exceeded". headers include `X-Request-ID: req_0a1b2c3d` and `Retry-After: 30`. This started ~2024-11-12T18:12:03Z.

lia-support: thanks — can you paste a redacted curl and the candidate_count you sent? also any response headers exactly as returned?

ashley-customer: curl snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' -d '{"query":"...","candidates":[{"text":"..."},... 200 items]}'`

lia-support: copied. Attach returned headers: `x-ratelimit-limit: 600`, `x-ratelimit-remaining: 0`, `x-ratelimit-reset: 1718429165`, `x-request-id: req_0a1b2c3d`, `content-type: application/json`, status 429. Looks like remaining==0 for their bucket even though their normal endpoints show remaining > 100.

jordan-eng-runtime: pinging infra/rate-limiter. Quick hypothesis: rerank endpoint counts per-candidate weight which is separate bucket, might be counting candidate_count * 2 incorrectly. Sending logs request id to ops.

kai-rl-ops: ops-bot report: `ALERT quota: rerank_candidate_units/min exceeded for org-987 by factor 3; window starting 1718429100`. Attached rate-limiter log: `Reject request req_0a1b2c3d org=org-987 route=/v1/rerank weight=300 bucket_remaining=0`

marta-qa: can reproduce locally with large payloads. Repro steps: 1) POST /v1/rerank with 200 candidates, 2) send identical requests at 10 rps for 1 minute -> bucket exhaustion and immediate 429s. Attached minimal repro curl.

jordan-eng-runtime: looking at code path — we apply weight = candidate_count * per_candidate_unit. For legacy rerank we used 1 unit/candidate; for v2 we intended 0.2 units/candidate to avoid bursts. I see a regression where config not loaded and default is 1.0, so large candidate sets will eat the entire candidate bucket.

lia-support: customer requests workaround while we patch. any short-term suggestions?

kai-rl-ops: temporary workarounds: 1) reduce candidates to <=50 per request, 2) add client-side batching with 200ms jitter and exponential backoff on 429, or 3) request a temporary quota bump for rerank_candidate_units (ops can do +2x for 24h).

ashley-customer: can you do the temp bump? Our production traffic is time-sensitive.

kai-rl-ops: added request for org-987 temporary bump +2x (case #RL-5421). Will hit prod within 10m. Also adding a short-term server-side flag to enforce per_candidate_unit=0.2 for rerank v2. Planning a hotfix release in the next deploy window.

jordan-eng-runtime: PR to fix config loading is in review: ensure per-route config is loaded before rate-limiter evaluation. Will include unit test and e2e simulated burst.

marta-qa: test plan: replicate customer traffic (200 candidates @ 10 rps) and verify no 429s after patch with per_candidate_unit=0.2. Also assert headers `X-RateLimit-Remaining` reflect candidate unit math.

lia-support: next steps for support: 1) inform customer of temp bump and recommended reduced candidate size, 2) share expected timeline for hotfix and deploy, 3) confirm if unexpected scores/zeros were observed (ashley?) — that might be separate.

ashley-customer: scores looked fine, just 429s. Thanks for the bump. Please confirm when hotfix is live.

ops-bot: Automation: temporary quota applied to org-987 until 1718515535. change_id=chg_77b9.

jordan-eng-runtime: marking incident: rl/2024-11-12-candidate-count-default-regression, assigning to eng-runtime + rl-ops, severity P2. Will follow up with root-cause and postmortem.

lia-support: closing loop: told customer to reduce batch size and use backoff. We'll re-open if they see more 429s after bump ends.

marta-qa: note for postmortem: add telemetry that emits `candidate_units_consumed` per request and map to `org` so we can alert earlier when candidate unit burn is abnormal.

lia-support: thanks everyone. action items captured in #incidents and ticket RL-5421. :thumbsup:
